rationale: Three payload/surface defects that only a fixture can hold, pinned together because each is 'a name or path a consumer resolves'. (1) M5: an arrow-function handler is a Function symbol and must receive the same apiContract extraction as a `function` declaration — `extractApiContract` already had an arrow_function branch, but the variable path never called it, so the dominant handler shape (Next.js/Astro/Express arrow consts) reported nothing while the identical function form reported a path. The `notAHandler` control proves the fix did not simply attach a contract to every arrow: a body with no HTTP call still gets none. (2) M4: an anonymous default export has no binding name, so `default` names no symbol anywhere; the two dangling `module -> default` edges are forbidden while the informational ExportInfo and the NAMED export edge are pinned, so the fix cannot be 'stop recording default exports'. (3) M8: linesOfCode is a cross-language metric — the same source reported 6 as .ts (non-empty lines only) and 9 as .js (all lines), measured 6 vs 9 on this exact file's shape; the pin is the authored line count, and the pre-fix non-empty count is recorded in the rationale so the two are distinguishable by a reader.
